intake_facts: FY2026 revenue was $1.316191B, Subscription ARR was $1.462092B, OCF was $282.908M, property/equipment capex was $29.631M and capitalized internal-use software was $15.437M.
Q2 FY2027 revenue was $427.260M; Subscription ARR was $1.660903B and management reported ARR growth of 33% y/y.
H1 FY2027 OCF was $158.535M, property/equipment capex $9.876M, capitalized internal-use software $9.374M and SBC $174.386M.
2026-07-31 cash was $416.166M and short-term investments $1.331483B versus convertible notes carrying value $1.132895B; balance-sheet net cash is $614.754M before lease and other adjustments.
FY2027 company guidance published 2026-08-27 calls for revenue $1.685B-$1.693B, Subscription ARR $1.880B-$1.885B, FCF $323M-$333M and approximately 228M weighted-average shares.
TTM to 2026-07-31 estimate from FY2026 plus H1 FY2027 less H1 FY2026: revenue $1.542178B and OCF $337.064M.

TTM company-style FCF proxy after property/equipment capex and capitalized internal-use software is about $286.242M. After subtracting TTM SBC of about $341.763M as an economic owner-cost stress test, owner-FCF proxy is about -$55.521M; this is a downstream estimate, not an FP fact.
Remaining non-cancelable performance obligations were approximately $2.62B at 2026-07-31; approximately 53% was expected to be recognized over the next 12 months.
Q2 FY2027 channel-partner revenue concentration was approximately 26%, 28%, 10% and 10% for Partners A-D; this is channel concentration and not disclosed ultimate end-customer concentration.
H1 FY2027 geographic revenue mix was approximately 70.92% Americas, 24.31% EMEA and 4.77% APAC.
